'''Aqzow''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lieutenant Colonel]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] trainer in the [[Havoc Squadron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He operated out of the [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] [[Labor Outpost]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', Aqzow was identified as Lt. Col. Aqzow, short for Lieutenant Colonel.
